name: Workable
summary: Workable sells three applicant tracking plans priced by company size, and the page shows only the 1 to 20 employee band: $299, $599 and $719 a month. Texting, video interviews and assessments cost extra on the cheapest plan, and its AI agents draw on prepaid credits.

facts.text: Workable's job posting page advertises one-click posting to 200+ sites.
Interviewers complete scorecards with a 3-point rating scale, and the evaluations can be viewed one by one or in aggregate.
Each ATS plan includes 3,000 AI credits. Credit packs start at 5,000 credits for $600, and credits expire one year after purchase.
Workable's terms let it raise renewal fees by up to 5% with at least 45 days' notice.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $3,588 a year when billed annually. Unlimited active jobs under fair usage limits.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: $7,188 a year. Texting, video interviews, assessments and referrals are included.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $8,628 a year. Same included add-ons as Premier.

hiddenCosts: Prices for companies above 20 employees are not shown on the page.
On Standard, Texting+ costs $89 a month, Video interviews+ $109, Assessments+ $59 and Performance & Engagement+ $39.
The Sourcing, Screening and Engagement agents are add-ons that use AI credits, and the free trial does not include Workable Agent.

contract.cancellation: Subscriptions renew for successive one-year terms. Cancel before the anniversary or end date. Fees are generally non-refundable, and early termination does not refund prepaid fees.
contract.dataExport: The terms say Workable must provide tools to export or retrieve the customer's data on termination and at any time before it.
